what_it_is.prose: MBDA is the European missile systems prime and a strategic Indian partner through two principal channels: (i) weapons integration on the IAF's 36 Dassault Rafale fighters — the MICA IR/RF air-to-air missile (used in the May 2025 Pakistan clash) and Meteor beyond-visual-range missile; MBDA announced in May 2026 an agreement with the IAF to establish local MRO capability for the MICA missile; and (ii) the L&T MBDA Missile Systems Ltd JV (formed Feb 2017, missile integration facility operational Feb 2020) — India's first private-sector missile JV with a foreign OEM, offering fifth-generation ATGMs and naval missiles. MBDA also signed a Sep 2019 agreement with BDL to assemble missiles in India and has offered Brimstone integration on India's future MQ-9B fleet (Nov 2023).

faq.question: Which MBDA missiles are integrated on India's Rafale fighters?
faq.answer: The IAF's 36 Dassault Rafale fighters are equipped with two MBDA air-to-air missiles: the MICA (IR/RF) as the primary short/medium-range weapon, and the Meteor beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile. MICA was the only AAM carried during the May 2025 India-Pakistan air clash. In May 2026 MBDA announced an agreement with the IAF to establish local MRO capability for the MICA missile.

faq.question: What is the L&T MBDA joint venture?
faq.answer: L&T MBDA Missile Systems Ltd is a 50:50 joint venture formed in February 2017 between Larsen & Toubro (India) and MBDA Missile Systems. Its missile integration facility became operational in February 2020 — India's first private-sector missile JV with a foreign OEM. The JV offers fifth-generation ATGMs and naval missiles for Indian requirements, and showcased capabilities at Aero India 2025.

faq.question: Has MBDA offered Brimstone missiles to India?
faq.answer: Yes. In November 2023 MBDA publicly confirmed it is ready to consider integration of Brimstone precision-strike missiles onto the MQ-9B SeaGuardian/SkyGuardian Predator drones being procured by India from General Atomics — providing a potential European precision-strike option for India's future HALE RPAS fleet.
